findings.title: [P1] Keep the branch argument out of the command shell
findings.body: When `branch` contains shell metacharacters (for example, `main; touch /tmp/pwn`), `exec()` passes the interpolated string to a shell and executes the appended command with the application's privileges. It also stops treating valid branch names as one literal Git argument. The previous `execFile("git", ["show", branch])` preserved the argument boundary and should be retained (or equivalent non-shell execution used).
